intro: Arkansas Legislative Audit examines every county and publishes what it finds. This page quotes what the auditors reported about Chicot County, from its latest report — no verdict added in either direction. What the auditors said is the record; what to make of it is yours.
regulatory_basis_note: Read this before reading any Arkansas audit: county and city reports carry a technical 'adverse opinion' on GAAP grounds because Arkansas law has them keep books on a simpler 'regulatory basis.' That phrase appears in every such audit in the state and signals the accounting format — not wrongdoing. A report is 'clean' or not in its findings, deficiencies, and noncompliance sections, which is what this page quotes.

verdicts.quote: During our evaluation, nothing came to our attention that would warrant disclosure in this report.
verdicts.detail: A limited review (a “financial and compliance report”), not a full audit: the financial statements in it are unaudited.

limits: From the 2024 report, dated February 9, 2026. Read by machine from the report’s text; the quotes are the auditors’ words. Older reports, and the separate federal (single) audits, aren’t on this page yet.
Arkansas alternates between full audits and limited “financial and compliance” reviews; each line says which this is.

cities.name: Dermott
cities.quote: The result of our tests disclosed instances of noncompliance or other matters that are required to be reported under Government Auditing Standards and which are described in the Report on Internal Control over Financial Reporting section as item 2024-1. We identified certain deficiencies in internal control, described below as item 2024-1, that we consider to be a material weakness.

cities.name: Eudora
cities.quote: Noncompliance with state law and accepted accounting practices was noted in the offices of Mayor, Clerk/Treasurer, and District Court Clerk. Mayor Review of debit card charges for the period January 1, 2022 through December 31, 2023, revealed the following improper/questionable purchases totaling $14,179: • $9,533 for undocumented disbursements, the validity of which could not be determined. • $1,686 for lodging and meals without a business purpose indicated. • $1,182 for decorations.

cities.name: Lake Village
cities.quote: Noncompliance with state law and accepted accounting practices was noted in the offices of Mayor, Chief Financial Officer, City Clerk, Police Chief, and District Court Clerk. Mayor The governing body did not adopt the budgets by ordinance for 2023 and 2022, as required by Ark. Code Ann. § 14-58-202.
